handedness_note: MediaPipe labels assume mirrored/selfie images. Physical left/right requires knowing whether saved pixels were mirrored; RTMPose adapter has no handedness output. Training and live labels compared under the same MP convention.
limitations: Normalized tip-wrist distance is a flexion proxy, not a direct physical finger angle. Central 90% ranges and full ranges are both reported; overlapping ranges do not identify a class.
Wrong_BGR deliberately violates the RGB API; it is a diagnostic control, not a deployment candidate.
Resize/flip improvements alone do not establish a live-vs-file mismatch, since the two paths supply identical arrays.

conclusion.decision: No runtime/model change; no preprocessing mismatch found.
conclusion.a_flip: CONFIRMED: hybrid 1/20 -> 0/20; MediaPipe 1/20 -> 4/20; does not rescue the hybrid.
conclusion.b_channels: CONFIRMED: actual Streamlit infer_image and validate_hybrid_live file loop produced identical RGB arrays 30/30. BGR control deliberately breaks the RGB contract.
conclusion.c_size: CONFIRMED: 613x344 once, 613x459 29 times. Representative outside Tripathaka size is 218x212; stretch and aspect-preserving fit both yield hybrid/MP 0/20. High-resolution control also does not rescue hybrid.
conclusion.d_features: CONFIRMED: live normalized ring median RT=0.9500, MP=0.9489. Original training medians Tripathaka/Pathaka RT=.7708/.9399, MP=.6842/.9104. Full ranges overlap for 18/20 RT and 20/20 MP live values; no scalar proves the class. INFERRED: the ring is represented too extended in many live frames. Tracker/visual ambiguity versus model boundary weakness remains UNVERIFIED without ground-truth landmarks.
conclusion.e_handedness: CONFIRMED: live MP Right 20/20; original detected training Tripathaka Left 304, Right 92 (76.8% opposite MP orientation). INFERRED physical Left under stock Streamlit unmirrored capture: local CameraInput default mirrored=false and MP docs assume mirrored inputs. Camera-driver mirroring and absolute physical handedness are UNVERIFIED. Flip failure argues against a simple handedness preprocessing fix.
conclusion.acceptance: CONFIRMED: all requested no-regression checks pass; live failures remain unresolved. No tuning/training performed.

acceptance.clean_method: production brain.predict; cached detector outputs on all validation records; fresh pixels separately
